note: Deck wording: How has the city I live in grown? Buildings are the existing panden of gemeente 0307: status Pand in gebruik, Pand in gebruik (niet ingemeten), Verbouwing pand, Sloopvergunning verleend or Pand buiten gebruik. Demolished, withdrawn and never built panden do not count. The decade is that of oorspronkelijkBouwjaar. 1990 has 16,885 panden, 1980 has 11,581. Counting homes (verblijfsobjecten with woonfunctie in a live status, by bouwjaarPand) also gives 1990, with 13,317 against 10,609. Narrowing an open question to the decade with the most buildings is a draft for the working group, who may prefer another measure of growth, such as a count per decade or the number of homes.
